findings.finding: Cancelled-Pages branch accepts a prior noExecutedRed snapshot based only on run ID/SHA. It does not require the same attempt, inspect final attempt jobs/steps or re-read a stable terminal run. A rerun or failure occurring after the earlier snapshot can be hidden by a later cancelled conclusion. Its text also claims cancellation occurred after verifiedCI7 and actual promotion without binding that chronology.
findings.requiredFix: Require candidate run ID and positive matching attempt; verify complete final job/step collection, reject every executed failure/timed_out/action_required/unknown, and re-read stable terminal cancellation. Bind prior no-red observation and actual CI/promotion receipt times before cancellation. Keep cancelled as cancelled, never successful. If reliable final cancellation evidence is unavailable, retain the pending/nonpassing state.
findings.resolution: Same positive attempt, complete unique expected jobs and final no-red completed steps required; successful executed jobs require nonempty steps. Producer and court re-read terminal run/attempt. Unsupported cancellation actor/timing claim removed; cancelled stays cancelled.

findings.resolution: Court snapshots input byte buffers, validates/hashes frozen bytes and refuses any checked file change. Final exact CI/image and Pages attempt/terminal readbacks must remain stable before acceptance.
